name: Document Loader
description: Detect a document's format from its bytes and parse it into one common page shape, naming the evidence behind every detection.
install: No dependencies; text, Markdown and HTML parse with the standard library. PDF adapters are injected: copy with: ragkit add document-loader
missing_dependency_message: document-loader needs no package. PDF is not parsed here -- pass a PdfAdapter wrapping whichever extractor your project uses, for example ragkit add pdf-extraction-pymupdf. A PDF handed to the loader with no adapter raises MissingAdapter naming the gap rather than substituting a parser.
